paired_final_analysis.interpretation: V4 improves paired workflow coverage but accepts4 wrong routes/104 and1 unsupported case/40.27 rule denials are not model probabilities;6 human requests were over-denied into unsupported scope. Every cancellation still needs an authorized exact-proposal approval. No model tuning followed this audit.

family_test_metrics.calibration_scope: Learned routes only. Deterministic scope-denial decisions are not probabilities and are excluded from calibration.

development_analysis.calibration_excludes: Deterministic scope-rule denials, which are not probabilities.
development_analysis.fresh_blind_workflow: not read by this analysis script
development_analysis.ablation_scope: Best feasible development configuration per architecture/blend; not a held-out comparison or independent generalization estimate.

split_audit.within_collection_checks: Training checks normalized duplicates and assigned groups do not cross each collection's splits.

source_validation_cleaning_sensitivity.reason: Every feasible candidate must correctly accept all14 core regressions; these3 normalized overlaps are identical core features. Removing them uniformly subtracts3 correct accepts. This can only tighten source error gates; selected candidate remains feasible and maximizes the unchanged ranking.

split_audit.limitations: This post-freeze audit does not retrain/tune the model. Raw reports are retained. No exact training overlap exists in source/domain test, domain calibration/validation, or fresh blind160. Approximate semantic/template overlaps beyond assigned groups may still exist.

retrieval_benchmark.labeling: Synthetic policies/queries and relevance labels authored by coding agent. No independent human adjudication.
retrieval_benchmark.lexical_semantics: Legacy all uses AND plainto_tsquery and retains zero-score ranks. New any uses parameterized OR websearch terms and excludes zero-score lexical entries from ranking/fusion. No main pipeline configuration is changed.
retrieval_benchmark.latency_scope: Warm retrieval with a new scoped runtime-role transaction per query; local CPU/PostgreSQL. Excludes fixture seed, routing, generation and provider calls.
retrieval_benchmark.limitations: 32 agent-authored synthetic queries,16 per split; no independent human relevance adjudication or representative traffic sample. Ranking comparison does not establish answer factuality or retrieval abstention on unknown topics. Main demo still retains its previous corpus/retrieval release.

cpu_resources.scope: One fresh Python process per model, same80 historical diagnostic messages. Cold model load/first query after library imports; warm per-message latency. Peak process RSS includes interpreter/libraries. Single local CPU run, no cloud cost/throughput inference.

source_baseline.threshold_selection: Validation only; maximize supported accepted coverage with <=2% accepted route error and <=1% OOD false acceptance.
source_baseline.calibration: Raw logistic probabilities; reliability bins and log loss reported. No probability guarantee; no post-hoc recalibration selected.

independent_synthetic.authoring: Coding-agent-authored synthetic cases frozen before training output; no independent human review; not real-customer performance.

routing_inference.scope: Classifier only; excludes database, retrieval and generation; individual frozen independent synthetic inputs.

interpretation: V4 primarily improves accepted workflow coverage versus v3, while raw paired macro-F1 is similar. Accepted errors4/104 and unsupported acceptance1/40 remain. Scope-rule decisions are not calibrated probabilities. Synthetic agent-authored groups do not establish real-customer or unattended-production quality.
